#[cfg(kani)]
mod proofs {
    #[kani::proof]
    fn verified_satisfied_cover() {
        let x: u8 = kani::any();
        kani::assume(x < 10);
        kani::cover!(x == 3, "x can be three");
        assert!(x < 10);
    }

    #[kani::proof]
    fn falsified_with_playback() {
        let x: u8 = kani::any();
        kani::assume(x < 10);
        kani::cover!(x == 3, "x can be three");
        assert!(x < 5);
    }

    #[kani::proof]
    fn unwind_exhausted() {
        let n: u8 = kani::any();
        let mut i: u8 = 0;
        kani::cover!(n == 100, "n can be large");
        while i < n {
            i += 1;
        }
        assert!(i == n);
    }

    #[kani::proof]
    fn vacuous_cover() {
        let x: u8 = kani::any();
        kani::assume(x > 5 && x < 3);
        kani::cover!(true, "unreachable cover");
        assert!(x < 10);
    }

    #[kani::proof]
    fn partial_cover() {
        let x: u8 = kani::any();
        kani::assume(x < 10);
        kani::cover!(x == 3, "x can be three");
        kani::cover!(x == 200, "x can be two hundred");
        assert!(x < 10);
    }

    #[kani::proof]
    fn no_cover() {
        let x: u8 = kani::any();
        kani::assume(x < 10);
        assert!(x < 10);
    }
}
